key_findings: NANOG transcriptionally upregulates TRPV1, which drives Ca2+-dependent autophagic EGF secretion and EGFR-AKT activation, conferring cisplatin resistance.
TRPV1 inhibition sensitizes cisplatin-resistant cervical cancer cells to cisplatin.
